text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I was just bemoaning the fact that my
very
presence here makes these posters
simply
disappear.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You can make posters disappear?!
Wowie! How're
you doing that?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, by standing here, of course! My
dazzling
countenance outshines all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling? You mean light makes them
disappear?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okie-dokie! Then I'll go grab a flashlight
and
help!
